title: 《台風6号被害》高知県内各地で道路冠水や土砂崩れ【高知】

en: [Typhoon No. 6 damage] Road flooding and landslides in various parts of Kochi Prefecture [Kochi]. Although there were no casualties in Kochi Prefecture, damage such as road flooding and landslides was confirmed in various areas. Extremely heavy rain fell in Shimanto Town, with a level 4 heavy rain warning being announced. The rainfall from the start of the rain until 6 a.m. on the 3rd was 450.5 mm in Kubokawa, Shimanto Town, and 436.5 mm in Funato, Tsuno Town.
